title: Power Apps: form fill assistance using Microsoft 365 files in model-driven apps
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, licensing requirements and documented control operations are supported. Microsoft documents the column-level control but does not call it the finest-grained control, and the checklist mentions column properties without a corresponding controls-table row.

claims.claim: This Power Apps change applies to model-driven apps.
claims.quote: Power Apps: Form fill assistance using Microsoft 365 files in model-driven apps

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: Microsoft plans to expand form fill assistance to use Microsoft 365 files as a source for form entries.
claims.quote: We’re expanding form fill assistance in Power Apps to use Microsoft 365 files as a source, helping users turn existing content into form entries with less manual effort.

claims.claim: The roadmap status is In development.

claims.claim: The roadmap target is January CY2027.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; What's changing; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated the arrival default specifically for the Microsoft 365 files extension.
claims.quote: Searched: "form fill assistance" "Microsoft 365 files" "settings" "default". Read roadmap description and Learn's Use AI form fill assistance and Manage feature settings; existing-feature defaults do not specify the extension's arrival default.

claims.claim: The documented form fill assistance licensing model is per user.
claims.quote: The form fill assistance requires specific user licenses based on the product.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Learn requires a Power Apps premium license for a Power Apps model-driven app user.
claims.quote: Power Apps model-driven app: The user must have a Power Apps premium license.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Learn requires a Dynamics 365 enterprise or premium license for a Dynamics 365 model-driven app user.
claims.quote: Dynamics 365 model-driven app: The user must have a Dynamics 365 enterprise or premium license as outlined in Dynamics 365 License Guide.

claims.claim: Under the documented license enforcement, users without the required license do not see the feature.
claims.quote: If the user doesn't have the license, the feature is hidden.

claims.claim: License enforcement rolls out gradually following general availability.
claims.quote: This license enforcement gradually rolls out following the feature's general availability.

claims.claim: The environment form fill assistance control is moving to Power Platform admin center > Copilot > Settings > Power Apps > Data entry.
claims.quote: The primary admin control for form fill assistance is moving to the Power Platform admin center under Copilot > Settings > Power Apps > Data entry.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls prose and table
claims.claim: No API for the Copilot Data entry environment control is documented as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: "form fill assistance" "Data entry" "API"; Power Platform form fill assistance Data entry environment API PowerShell. Opened form-filling-assistance, settings-features, copilot-hub and get-update-setting-value-using-code; no mapping to the new Data entry control.

claims.claim: The legacy AI form fill assistance section is under Manage > Environments > environment > Settings > Product > Features in the Power Platform admin center.
claims.quote: In the navigation pane, select Manage. ... In the Manage pane, select Environments. ... On the Environments page, select an environment. ... In the command bar, select Settings. ... Expand Product, and then select Features. ... AI form fill assistance

claims.claim: An API equivalent for the legacy environment form fill assistance switch is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "AI form fill assistance" "PowerShell" "environment"; "form fill assistance" "environment" "SaveSettingValue". Read settings-features, form-filling-assistance and the client setting API; no documented equivalent for this legacy environment switch.

claims.claim: Legacy environment controls are being removed in favor of the Copilot settings experience.
claims.quote: Admin controls for the AI form fill assistance feature are changing. The primary admin control moves to Copilot > Settings > Power Apps > Data entry.

claims.claim: Makers can configure the app's Form fill assist toolbar under App designer > Settings > Features.
claims.quote: When you select Settings from the command bar, select Features to enable or disable model-driven app features for the app. ... Form fill assist toolbar.

claims.claim: Xrm.Utility.getGlobalContext().saveSettingValue("FormFileUploadEnabled", true, { overrideScope: 2, solutionUniqueName: "<solution>" }) uses the documented method and options to save a setting for the current app.
claims.quote: Xrm.Utility.getGlobalContext().saveSettingValue(settingName, value, saveSettingOptions).then(successCallback, errorCallback); ... Use 2 to add or update a setting app value.

claims.where: controls[2].api; Governance controls prose and table
claims.claim: FormFileUploadEnabled is the app setting for the form fill assist toolbar, separate from the new primary environment control.
claims.quote: Smart paste (FormPredictSmartPasteEnabled) and form fill assist toolbar (FormFileUploadEnabled) app settings ... You can now configure these settings at the app level

claims.claim: App setting changes in the designer require saving and publishing the app.
claims.quote: You must select Publish to activate an app settings change. ... Save and Publish the app.

claims.claim: Neither an environment UI switch nor an API switch specific to Microsoft 365 files as a form fill source is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "form fill assistance" "Microsoft 365 files"; "form fill assistance" "Microsoft 365 files" "settings" "default". Opened form-filling-assistance, settings-features and copilot-hub; no extension-specific UI or API control found.

claims.claim: Learn describes existing form fill assistance as generally available in Dynamics 365 apps.
claims.quote: This feature is generally available in Dynamics 365 apps.

claims.claim: Learn describes existing form fill assistance as production-ready preview in Power Apps.
claims.quote: This feature is in production ready preview in Power Apps.

claims.claim: Current form fill assistance uses app usage, smart paste and user-provided files as suggestion sources.
claims.quote: based on the data they frequently use, or based on text or image they have copied and used smart paste (via button or keyboard shortcut) to paste into the form, or based on the file contents the user provides through the files capability.

claims.claim: The current Files capability supports txt, docx, csv, pdf and image files.
claims.quote: Supported file types are .txt, .docx, .csv, .pdf, .png, .jpg, .jpeg, and .bmp.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: The current Files capability does not support files classified with sensitivity labels.
claims.quote: Files classified with sensitivity labels aren't supported.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: The supported Microsoft 365 file locations and file-access boundaries of the planned extension are not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "form fill assistance" "Microsoft 365 files" "access". Read roadmap record and form-filling-assistance; uploaded files and Copilot-chat context are described, but no file locations or access mechanism for the roadmap extension.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not confirmed that current Files limits, including sensitivity-label handling, define the Microsoft 365 files extension.
claims.quote: Searched: "form fill assistance" "Microsoft 365 files"; "form fill assistance" "Microsoft 365 files" "access". Read roadmap record, form-filling-assistance and its FAQ; no passage specifies the extension's label handling or carries existing limits forward.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Suggestions are not saved until users accept them.
claims.quote: Suggestions are entirely optional and aren't saved in the app until you accept them.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; rationale: risk
claims.claim: AI-generated suggestions need user review for accuracy and appropriateness.
claims.quote: Users are always required to review suggestions and explicitly accept the suggestions that are accurate and appropriate.

claims.claim: Fields with column security are not currently supported.
claims.quote: Fields that have column security aren't currently supported.

claims.claim: Usage may be throttled.
claims.quote: Usage might be subject to service limits or throttling. Microsoft reserves the right to update the limits.

claims.claim: Additional licensing or charges specifically for the Microsoft 365 files source have not been published.
claims.quote: Searched: "form fill assistance" "Microsoft 365 files" "price"; Power Apps licensing form fill assistance Microsoft 365 files Copilot Credits consumption pricing. Read form-filling-assistance licensing and pricing excerpts; no extension-specific charge found.

claims.claim: Current Learn prerequisites describe form fill assistance for web apps with the modern look enabled.
claims.quote: Form fill assistance is available for all apps on the web where the modern, refreshed look is turned on.

claims.claim: Allow form fill assistance must be enabled for a column to receive form fill assistance.
claims.quote: The Allow form fill assistance column property enabled for the column where form fill assistance occurs.

claims.claim: Makers can configure the preview Allow form fill assistance property per column.
claims.quote: Allow form fill assistance (preview) ... This is a preview feature. When enabled, users receive suggestions generated by AI for columns that support form fill assistance in main and quick create forms.

claims.claim: The column property can be disabled for columns containing sensitive information.
claims.quote: You can disable for columns that might contain sensitive information, such as email address.

claims.claim: The per-column property is the finest-grained control.
claims.quote: Searched: "form fill assistance" "column" "granular". Opened create-edit-field-portal, form-filling-assistance and copilot-hub; these document column, app and environment controls but do not state the comparative claim.
claims.fix: Replace the sentence with: 'Makers can also set Allow form fill assistance (preview) per column and disable it for columns that might contain sensitive information.'

claims.claim: The Power Platform admin center's Copilot area reports data entry agent usage.
claims.quote: Admins can view usage analytics for the data entry agent and data exploration agent on the Power Apps page to understand the value that end users are getting from AI in Power Apps.

claims.claim: Suggestions include citations users can review.
claims.quote: Suggestions also include citations for reference by users.
